title: Home | Salamanderbooks
text: Please join us at our new home, The Allen Theatre in Annville PA!​ Just across from Lebanon Valley College and adjacent to the historic Allen Theatre, Salamander Bookstore Cafe offers a wide assortment of quality used books, records, CDs, DVDs and music gear. The cafe features all of the usual coffee options as well as baked goods.
